description: Multi-user claim falsification of the active spec's R2 accounting. Self swaps 10000 on A (fee 99, earned 49). Bob is funded with 20000 currency0, approves the dedicated router, and swaps 20000 on A through it (fee 199, earned 99 for Bob). Both users then claim exactly their own earned rebates (Bob 99, self 49) - each within their per-user cumulative entitlement, exactly as R2 and R4 require and as the patched contract enforces. The deterministic spec comparison nevertheless records an R2 violation at Bob's claim (pool-wide paid 99 exceeds the single modeled recipient's earned 49) and predicts self's fully-entitled claim of 49 must be rejected, while the contract correctly pays it. The spec and Lean model cover one recipient per pool, so multi-recipient claim accounting required by intent R2/R4 is misstated: a spec defect with a Lean coverage gap.
